source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修一 Unit 1 同主题完形(应聘小丑医生/马戏团的故事/讲好笑话/家庭晚餐趣事/加入喜剧社/爷爷的幽默)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,4选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位由 _balance 打散。

passages.title: Applying to Be a Clown Doctor
passages.text: Dear Sir or Madam, I saw your (1)____ for a part-time clown doctor and I would love to (2)____. Ever since I was a child, I have wanted to (3)____ sick people feel better. I am cheerful, patient and good at telling (4)____. I can also do simple magic (5)____, sing funny songs and make balloon animals. I understand that a clown doctor must be very (6)____, because some children are in too much pain to laugh. I would always work (7)____ with the doctors and nurses on the ward. Making a frightened child (8)____ again would be the best reward of all. I have included my CV and two (9)____ from my teachers. I really hope you will give me the (10)____ to join your wonderful team.

passages.title: The Story of the Circus

passages.title: How to Tell a Good Joke
passages.text: Telling a joke well is a real (1)____. First, you need to choose a story that your listeners will (2)____. passages.title: A Funny Family Dinner
passages.text: Last Sunday my whole family came together for (1)____. Everything was going well until my little brother told a (2)____ that he had heard at school. passages.title: Joining the Comedy Club
passages.text: When I first joined the school (1)____ club, I was terribly nervous. I had always wanted to make people (2)____, but standing alone on a stage felt frightening. passages.title: My Grandfather's Sense of Humour
passages.text: My grandfather has the best sense of (1)____ of anyone I know. Even when life is (2)____, he always finds something to laugh about.
